question: What expiatory act restores purity to the two offenders described earlier?
premises: A set of three prājāpatya expiations is performed.
The two offenders undergo this performance.
inference: By performing three prājāpatya expiations, those two will become purified.
uncertainties: The identity of tau depends on the preceding context.
plain_english: Having performed three prājāpatya expiations, those two will become purified.
